info.description:
Configure the Quilr LLM Gateway programmatically: apps, shared providers, quota pools, gateway keys, prompts, budgets and history.

**Authentication.** Tenant administrators enable management for a tenant and issue management keys with the Administration endpoints (verified tenant administrator token). Every other endpoint takes a management key as `Authorization: Bearer qlmgmt_...`. Each operation lists the scopes it requires in `x-scopes`; an empty list on an Administration operation means a verified tenant administrator token.

**Writes.** Updates and deletes of an existing resource require `If-Match` with the quoted `version` (ETag) from the latest read (`428` when missing, `412` when stale). Creates take an `Idempotency-Key`; retrying with the same key replays the original result for 24 hours. Saved configuration reaches the gateway asynchronously.

**Responses.** Every JSON response carries `request_id` (also in `X-Request-ID`) and `Cache-Control: no-store`. Errors use `{"error": {"code", "message", ...}, "request_id"}`. Lists are paginated with `limit` and an opaque `cursor` (`next_cursor` is null on the last page).

**Policy.** General QuilrQL policy authoring is not part of this API. Budget and pricing edits (scope `budgets:policy`) are the only policy-backed writes: each publishes a validated policy revision. When QuilrQL governs a tenant, app settings it governs are saved but take effect only when policy authority is disabled; responses flag them with an `inactive_under_quilrql` warning.

Apps whose names contain `/` or a literal `%` can be addressed with the query-locator aliases under `/app?app_name=...` (marked with `x-alias-of`).
